title: I. The Sunlit Harvest
subheading: Beneath the Tuscan sun, ripe San Marzano plum tomatoes and sweet Mediterranean herbs are gathered by hand at dawn.
quote: “Every great pizza begins in the soil.”

title: II. The Fire & Handcrafted Stone
subheading: Inside the stone archway, our pizzaiolo kneads 48-hour slow-fermented dough while white oak embers crackle at 900°F.
quote: “Fire is not merely heat; it is an ingredient.”

title: III. Piazza & Osteria Crust & Ember
subheading: Overlooking the azure coastline, neighbours and travellers unite around striped awnings, rustic wine, and the laughter of convivial feasts.
quote: “To eat together is to dwell in joy.”

title: IV. The Golden Crust & Melted Mozzarella
subheading: Blistered leopard-spotted crust, rich reduction of sweet tomato sugo, molten Fior di Latte cheese, and hand-torn basil.
